name: AIOStreams
description: AIOStreams consolidates multiple Stremio addons and debrid services into a single, highly customisable super-addon, with filtering, sorting, and formatting of results.

notes.text: No authentication is enabled by default. Set AIOSTREAMS_AUTH in /opt/aiostreams/.env to secure the dashboard.
SECRET_KEY is generated automatically and cannot be changed after first run without invalidating existing encrypted configs. Back up /opt/aiostreams/.env.
Uses SQLite by default. Edit DATABASE_URI in /opt/aiostreams/.env to use PostgreSQL instead.
Most configuration (addons, presets, formatting, proxying) is done from the dashboard Settings page after deployment, not via the .env file.
